driver: The decisive quantity is the share of future tasks that will need longer than a new, shorter allowance, where each past task shows how long it needed only when it ran past its own allowance and every task that finished within its allowance shows only that it needed no more; the share is observed in full only on the past tasks whose allowance was already shorter than the new one, so it is read there (or by a product-limit estimate treating the hidden ones as censored), not from all observed durations or from the overruns alone.
driver_concrete: Each carrier relationship's share of 2027 turns that will need longer than its filed ground time is read from the summer 2026 turns whose available time (scheduled departure less on-block) was already shorter than that ground time, where readiness is fully observed, or equivalently from a reverse-time product-limit estimate; a turn that pushed back on time only shows it needed no more than the time it had.
stump: The default path counts as needing longer than the filed 2027 ground time only the 2026 turns that visibly overran by more than it (every on-time pushback read as ready in time), so the shortened proposals read well under the authority's 20 per cent and are accepted, where the turns that had less time than the proposal show more than 20 per cent needing longer for some relationships.
analyst_test: A strong analyst who conforms the stand log, the filed schedules, the operators' flight logs and their delay codes correctly reads each turn's need from its overrun, counting every on-time pushback as ready within the new ground time (or takes every observed ground time as the need), and so accepts every shortened proposal (or sends every one back), where the share observed on the turns that had less time than the proposal sends back only some.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is a tail probability of a duration left-censored by a schedule allowance, estimated the way statistics treats censored durations (the indicator is complete only where the allowance fell below the threshold, and a reverse-time product-limit estimate agrees); replacing it with the share of observed ground times or of overruns, a generic summary, changes which relationships are sent back.

differentiation.task450: 450 v1 read durations from scheduled visits that sample time in proportion to length (an inspection-paradox weighting); this build reads a duration's upper tail that an allowance hides (left-censoring), complete only where the old allowance was shorter than the threshold.
differentiation.task126: 126 split units a succession link had joined (an identity question on the unit); this build has no identity question: every turn is one unit, and the decisive move is estimating its needed time under censoring by the schedule.
differentiation.task101: 101 cut a threshold from a distribution the decision's own earlier payments had entered, so the population to cut from was a published total less a component; this build cuts a duration distribution whose values an allowance hid, so the cut is estimated under censoring, with no component to remove.
